spans.s: † प्लक्ष् प्लक्ष्, v. r. of भक्ष्.

प्लक्ष, m.
 1. The holy figtree, Ficus religiosa,

. The waved-leaf fig-tree, Ficus infectoria.
 3. Another tree, Hibiscus populneoides.
 4. One of the seven Dvīpas or divisions of the world.
 5. A side door.
† प्लब् प्लब्, and प्लब् प्लव्, i. 1, Ātm. To go; cf. प्लु.

प्लव, i. e. प्लु + अ,
 I. adj. Leaping, jumping.
 II. m.
 1.

. Swimming, Bhartṛ. i. 19 (cf. Böhtl. Roth. Sskr. Wörterbuch. s. v. पुलकय्).
 3. A raft, a boat, Pañc. ii. d. 42.
 4. A frog.
 5. A monkey.
 6. A sort of duck,

. A declivity or shelving ground.
 8. A sort of basket or snare for catching fish.
 --Comp.
 --Cf. πλόος.
प्लवक, i. e. प्लु + अक, m. A tumbler, a man who walks on the edge of a sword, etc.

प्लवंग, i. e. प्लव + म्-ग (vb. गम्), m.
 1. A monkey.
 2. A deer.

प्लवंगम, i. e. प्लव + म्-गम् + अ, m.
 1. A monkey,

प्लवन, i. e. प्लु + अन, n.
 1.
